H6106.gloss: body, bone, [idiom] life, (self-) same, strength, [idiom] very.
H6106.def: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame

H6119.gloss: heel, (horse-) hoof, last, lier in wait (by mistake for H6120 (עָקֵב)), (foot-) step.
H6119.def: a heel (as protuberant); hence, a track; figuratively, the rear (of an army)

H6172.def: nudity, literally (especially the pudenda) or figuratively (disgrace, blemish)

H6135.def: sterile (as if extirpated in the generative organs)

H6186.gloss: put (set) (the battle, self) in array, compare, direct, equal, esteem, estimate, expert (in war), furnish, handle, join…
H6186.def: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications)

H6113.gloss: [idiom] be able, close up, detain, fast, keep (self close, still), prevail, recover, refrain, [idiom] reign, restrain,…
H6113.def: to inclose; by analogy, to hold back; also to maintain, rule, assemble

H6118.gloss: [idiom] because, by, end, for, if, reward.
H6118.def: a heel, i.e. (figuratively) the last of anything (used adverbially, for ever); also result, i.e. compensation; and so (adverb with preposition or relatively) on account of

H6168.gloss: leave destitute, discover, empty, make naked, pour (out), rase, spread self, uncover.
H6168.def: to be (causatively, make) bare; hence, to empty, pour out, demolish

H6105.gloss: break the bones, close, be great, be increased, be (wax) mighty(-ier), be more, shut, be(-come, make) strong(-er).
H6105.def: to bind fast, i.e. close (the eyes); intransitively, to be (causatively, make) powerful or numerous; to crunch the bones

H6196.def: the plane tree (from its smooth and shed bark)

H6147.def: Er, the name of two Israelites

H6148.gloss: engage, (inter-) meddle (with), mingle (self), mortgage, occupy, give pledges, be(-come, put in) surety, undertake.
H6148.def: to braid, i.e. intermix; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange)

H6131.gloss: dig down, hough, pluck up, root up.
H6131.def: to pluck up (especially by the roots); specifically, to hamstring; figuratively, to exterminate

H6189.def: uncircumcised (i.e. still having the prepuce uncurtailed)

H6154.def: the web (or transverse threads of cloth); also a mixture, (or mongrel race)

H6187.gloss: equal, estimation, (things that are set in) order, price, proportion, [idiom] set at, suit, taxation, [idiom] valuest.

H6116.def: an assembly, especially on afestival or holiday

H6155.def: a willow (from the use of osiers as wattles)

H6166.def: Arad, the name of a place near Palestine, also of a Canaanite and an Israelite

H6160.gloss: Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness. See also H1026 (בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה).
H6160.def: a desert; especially (with the article prefix) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea

H6177.def: Aroer, the name of three places in or near Palestine

H6100.def: Etsjon-Geber, a place on the Red Sea

H6137.def: a scorpion; figuratively, a scourge or knotted whip

H6159.def: Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan

H6139.def: an Ekronite or inhabitant of Ekron

H6152.def: Arab (i.e. Arabia), a country East of Palestine

H6163.def: an Arabian or inhabitant of Arab (i.e. Arabia)

H6126.def: Akkub, the name of five Israelites

H6184.gloss: mighty, oppressor, in great power, strong, terrible, violent.

H6117.gloss: take by the heel, stay, supplant, [idiom] utterly.
H6117.def: to seize by the heel; figuratively, to circumvent (as if tripping up the heels); also to restrain (as if holding by the heel)

H6149.gloss: be pleasant(-ing), take pleasure in, be sweet.

H6195.def: trickery; or (in a good sense) discretion

H6140.def: to knot or distort; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse)

H6191.gloss: [idiom] very, beware, take crafty (counsel), be prudent, deal subtilly.
H6191.def: properly, to be (or make) bare; but used only in the derivative sense (through the idea perhaps of smoothness) to be cunning (usually in a bad sense)

H6170.def: something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre

H6183.def: the sky (as dropping at the horizon)

H6176.def: a juniper (from its nudity of situation)

H6188.gloss: count uncircumcised, foreskin to be uncovered.
H6188.def: to expose or remove the prepuce, whether literal (to go naked) or figurative (to refrain from using)
